questions.question: What did Judah say the man in Egypt had warned his brothers before they could return for more food?

answers.text: They would not see his face again without their brother
They would not get more grain unless they paid double
They would not leave Egypt alive a second time

questions.question: During the famine, what did Judah offer his father Israel about their youngest brother Benjamin?

answers.text: He would personally guarantee Benjamin's safety
He would give his own two sons as a pledge
He would hire guards to watch over Benjamin

questions.question: Who did Joseph's steward say gave his brothers the silver they found in their sacks?

answers.text: A servant who made a mistake

questions.question: When Joseph saw his younger brother Benjamin at his house in Egypt, why did he hurry out of the room?

answers.text: He was moved to tears for his brother
He was moved to anger for his brother
He was moved to laughter for his brother
